name: snagboat
description: Watches Claude Code and GitHub Copilot agents in VS Code: token usage, tool activity, and signs of trouble like looping, churn, stalls, and budget overruns. All local.
author: DChristianson

commands.title: Snagboat: Remove Claude Code Hooks from Project...

snagboat.captureContent.markdownDescription: Store text from your agent sessions: your prompts (up to 2,000 characters each), agent reply excerpts (up to 500 characters), and session names. Common secret formats (API keys, tokens, private keys, passwords in `key=value` form) are redacted before anything is stored. Prompts and replies are kept for `#snagboat.retention.textDays#` days; session names for as long as the session's events (`#snagboat.retention.rawDays#`). Nothing is sent off-machine. **Snagboat: Remove Captured Text** deletes what's already stored. For Copilot editor features' reply text, also requires `github.copilot.chat.otel.captureContent`.

snagboat.claudeCode.configureHooks.markdownDescription: Add Snagboat's `PostToolUse` and `Stop` hooks to each workspace folder's `.claude/settings.json`, for tool calls and turn ends. Turn off for a folder to leave its settings alone; **Snagboat: Remove Claude Code Hooks from Project...** removes existing entries and turns this off. Token usage still comes from transcripts either way.

snagboat.retention.rawDays.description: Days of raw structural events to keep, counting today. Older days are rolled up into daily aggregates and their raw events deleted.

snagboat.retention.aggregateDays.description: Days of daily aggregates to keep, counting today. -1 keeps them indefinitely; 0 keeps none, so raw days past snagboat.retention.rawDays are deleted without being rolled up.

snagboat.retention.textDays.markdownDescription: Days captured prompts and reply excerpts are kept, counting today. Older events keep everything else, with the text removed. Capped at `#snagboat.retention.rawDays#`. The default matches how long Claude Code keeps its own transcripts.

snagboat.copilot.captureStructure.markdownDescription: Development aid: record the *structure* of the telemetry Copilot sends (span names, parent links, timings, attribute names, and numeric values such as token counts) to Snagboat's global storage, for mapping Copilot's spans to Snagboat events. Every text value is replaced by its length, so no prompts, replies, arguments, or paths are recorded. Summarize with `npm run summarize:copilot` in the Snagboat repo.

snagboat.copilot.otlpPort.description: Local port Snagboat listens on for Copilot Chat's OpenTelemetry export. Point github.copilot.chat.otel.otlpEndpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<this port>.

snagboat.heuristics.stalled.minutes.description: Warn when an unfinished turn (prompted, no turn end yet) has had no agent activity for this many minutes. A finished turn going quiet never fires.

snagboat.heuristics.stalled.maxMinutes.description: Stop warning after this many quiet minutes: the turn is treated as abandoned (an agent closed mid-turn never records a turn end).

snagboat.tokenBudget.session.description: Warn when a single session's token usage crosses this total. Unset by default (no check).

snagboat.tokenBudget.day.description: Warn when this workspace's token usage for the current day crosses this total. Unset by default (no check).

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.window.description: Rolling window, in minutes, that tool-churn looks back over.

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.minCalls.description: Minimum tool calls within the window before tool-churn can fire.

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.minShare.description: tool-churn fires when the two most-hit targets account for at least this share of a session's targeted tool calls within the window.

snagboat.heuristics.verbalHedge.window.description: Rolling window, in minutes, that verbal-hedge looks back over. Only active when snagboat.captureContent is on.

snagboat.heuristics.verbalHedge.minTurns.description: Minimum replies in one session within the window that hedge or self-correct before verbal-hedge fires.

snagboat.heuristics.backtracking.minFail.description: Failed tool calls on the same target within one turn before backtracking fires.

snagboat.heuristics.backtracking.minEdit.description: Edits to the same file within one turn before backtracking fires.

snagboat.heuristics.runawayTurn.maxModel.description: runaway-turn fires when one prompt drives this many model calls (main agent and subagents) without another prompt.

snagboat.heuristics.runawayTurn.maxToolC.description: runaway-turn fires when one prompt drives this many tool calls without another prompt.

snagboat.heuristics.contextPressure.perc.description: context-pressure reports (info) when the current turn's context reaches this percentage of the model's limit. An automatic compaction always warns.

snagboat.heuristics.cacheThrash.minToken.description: A model call counts as a cache rewrite when it writes at least this many tokens to the prompt cache and more than it reads from it.

snagboat.heuristics.cacheThrash.minCalls.description: Cache rewrites within one turn before cache-thrash fires.
